How cyber agile is your organisation?
Discover how leading businesses proactively manage cyber risk while leveraging a secure IT ecosystem as a platform for resilient growth.
Discover cyber agility
Managed security controls
Keep your cloud environments and identities safe from cyber attacks with our range of security controls.
Cloud security
Keep your cloud-based data, information and networks secure with our intelligent cloud security.
Firewall security
Protect your most important assets with a managed firewall. Core protection for the constantly evolving threat landscape.
DDoS security
Don’t let a distributed denial of service (DDoS) attack take you down. With our DDoS security, you can detect and neutralise attacks before they hit your network.

Threat management
Get to the root cause of alerts and snuff out threats before they become a problem.
Threat intelligence
Protect your critical assets and stay ahead of cyber attackers with intelligence you can act upon.
SIEM
Get full visibility across your entire estate with our ready-to-use and fully managed SIEM services.
EDR and XDR security
Spot cyber attacks long before they’re a threat, with our managed EDR and XDR solutions from Microsoft and CrowdStrike.

Security consulting
We can help you design the right security solution for your business – whether you’re a global corporation or just starting out in business.
Cyber security for small businesses
Affordable and scalable security solutions to protect your reputation, your team and your clients.
Security consulting for corporations
Have confidence in your security strategies – assess, build and test your defences.
Ethical hacking services
Our ethical hacking services identify vulnerabilities before attackers do. From network vulnerabilities to employee behaviours, we help secure your business against cyber threats, helping you stay protected.

Mobile security
Keep your mobile devices and data protected from threats.
Mobile security
Adopt a Zero Trust approach to mobile security and let your people use the devices they want, when they want.

Surveillance
Protect your people and property with smart cameras, industrial sensors for Internet of Things (IoT) and digital connectivity.
Surveillance networks
Keep your control room and your sensors connected using the latest fixed, mobile and wireless networks.
Control rooms
Make sure the heart of your security operation is equipped with the latest tools and tech.
Cameras
Transform security and safety across your organisation with the latest cameras.

Drone solutions
Discover the latest drone technology making remote monitoring, aerial inspections and detection possible.
Drone detection
Explore our tailored Drone Detection services with BT Business. Comprehensive protection including airports, stadiums, and critical infrastructure.
Drone Survey Services
Explore our professional Drone Survey Services with BT Business. Delivering precise data and insights for property, commercial, and infrastructure projects.
Drone SIM
Enhance your drone’s capabilities with BT Drone SIM cards from BT Business. Achieve extended range, high-altitude flights, and uninterrupted connectivity.

Why choose BT for security
Global reach
With 3,000 security professionals, we’re one of the biggest security and business continuity practices in the world.
First-hand experience
The solutions we offer our customers are built with the same technology we use to protect our own organisation and critical national infrastructure.
Recognised for our security
IDC MarketScape named us a leader in their managed security services vendor assessment.
Trust
We deliver real-time surveillance solutions to corporations and public sector organisations, including local authorities, public transport, police forces and the UK Ministry of Defence.
We’re committed to hitting net zero by 2031. We’re also helping our customers reduce CO2 emissions by 60 million tonnes by 2030. Discover more about our sustainability commitment, for our business and yours.
